description: This file defines a React functional component 'DynamicAgentFormFields' used to render a dynamic form for agent configuration, including various input fields, credential metadata, and cost configuration. It also exports a utility function 'buildDynamicAgentData' to construct agent data objects from form values based on agent type information.

methods.name: buildDynamicAgentData
methods.description: Builds an agent data object from form values and agent type info, including litellm_params, credential fields, and cost settings.
